reviews.title: Not what it used to be
reviews.text:
I came to this game looking for a replacement for Idle Heroes. To my luck, I stumbled upon this game which is literally a copy of Idle Heroes (nothing against that). If you played Idle Heroes and played this game, you would notice it is not a coincidence that Erde looks almost exactly like Aida… and much more.

I’ve played it for a couple weeks now. I’ve loved it up until recently. It was extremely fun for the first few days but has got really boring lately. The developers fail to repair the MANY bugs yet continue to release game updates. There are simple things that could be made better such as how guilds operate or an auto run in the Tower. Once you have a lineup in this game, you’re practically set and stuck with that lineup. You’ll have little to no luck summoning heroes unless you buy them with money. I spun 80 premium scrolls and only got one 5 star hero. But suddenly, when I spend 2k gems, I *miraculously* pull two red border 5 stars. Because the luck of pulling good heroes is SO low in this game, you’ll be stuck with a bunch of hero exp and gold that you’re unable to spend to upgrade heroes because you can’t pull duplicates of the heroes you want to evolve. I’ve probably spent 50+ Ancient Relics on only the Dark summon and have only received 2 5 star heroes. I’m level 138 and still have yet to obtain a single red border water hero. 

Another note. The balancing in this game is horrendous. Zalidus, Nero, and Icarus are the best heroes in this game BY FAR. For example, my arena power is just over a million. A team in the arena with a power of 550k with an 8 star Zalidus and the rest of their lineup being normal 6 stars will defeat me every time—same goes for Nero. In the lineup recommendations, the game literally recommends to have two Zalidus’ on your lineup because he carries so much—too much. 

Additionally, the active member count in my server crashed extremely fast over the past 5 days. My guild that was once getting 26/20 war registrations has now failed to register for a guild war because half of my players don’t play anymore and moved on to something better.

Look at other Idle Games like ML: Adventure, where you get an SSR hero every single 10 roll. It has amazing graphics and you’ll never get bored. It’s not a pay to win like this game, either. I haven’t spent a dime in that game and the game literally hands you good characters. The developers of Summoners Era consistently say in the Discord server, “Oh we are working to fix that” yet it’s been an ongoing issue for weeks.
